title: StrataDocument
description: A Strata music analysis document (.strata file). The file format is the core invention — everything else is downstream of getting this schema right.

strataVersion.description: Version of the Strata app that created this file (semver string). Used for diagnosing compatibility issues.

fileFormatVersion.description: Schema version number. Starts at 1. Increment when the schema changes incompatibly. The app uses this to decide whether to run a migration before loading.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of file creation. Set once on first save; never updated.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last save. Updated on every save.

title.description: Display title of the track or recording.

artist.description: Performer or artist name(s). Array to support multiple artists cleanly — e.g. ['The Chainsmokers', 'Halsey']. Single-artist tracks use a one-element array.

context.description: Nature of the artifact. 'recording' = studio recording; 'performance' = live performance of a composed work. Optional — null if unspecified. Controls which additional fields (composer, work) are surfaced in the UI. Encourage analysts to set this before cross-corpus comparison.

duration.description: Track duration in seconds (float). Stored explicitly so span timestamps can be validated against the total length.

composer.description: Composer of the work. Surfaced in UI when context = 'performance'.

work.description: Composition identifier — e.g. 'Piano Sonata Op. 13'. Enables cross-file corpus comparison of different performances of the same work.

notes.description: Document-level free text. Methodological notes, analytical caveats, summary of findings. Distinct from the Written Analysis widget (timestamped, structured prose) — this is a simple overview field.

bpm.description: Beats per minute of the track. Used by the BPM grid utility to generate bar-level time points in the shared pool for span boundary snapping. Null if not applicable or not set. For variable-tempo tracks, set the dominant BPM and adjust individual time points manually.

project.description: Corpus or collection tag. Used by the Corpus Builder to group related analysis files — e.g. 'anthemics-edm-corpus'.

sharedTimePoints.description: Document-level time point pool. Any widget layer can contribute timestamps here; any widget can snap to or reference any point in the pool regardless of what created it.

layers.description: Ordered array of widget layer instances.

pointMarkers.description: Document-level point markers. Events in the recording (medial caesura, energy peak, flagged observation). Stored at the document level so they are visible across all layers without duplication.

showCadenceCaptions.description: Whether cadence-related point marker detail (type abbreviation, harmonic context) renders on the diagram. Point markers aren't layer-owned, so this is document-level rather than per-layer. Omit/absent = true (shown).

DerivativeReference.description: When this track is derived from another (remix, cover, re-recording, etc.), this field records the relationship. Null for original recordings.

sourceTrack.description: Filename of the analysis file representing the source track — e.g. 'heroes-original.strata'.

relationship.description: Nature of the derivative relationship. Suggested values: 'remix', 'cover', 'rerecording', 'arrangement'. Free text is accepted — the suggested list is not exhaustive.

TimeSignature.description: Time signature of the track. Used with bpm to generate the BPM grid. Null if not set.

numerator.description: Number of beats per measure — e.g. 4 in common time.

denominator.description: Note value that receives one beat, expressed as a power of 2 — e.g. 4 = quarter note.

HomeKey.description: The document's tonic and mode. Lets Span.keyArea and PointMarker.harmonicContext store a Roman-numeral RELATIONSHIP (e.g. 'vi', 'V/V') rather than an absolute key name, since the relationship is what's corpus-queryable across pieces in different keys. Null if not set.

tonic.description: Free text — e.g. 'A', 'F#', 'Bb'. Spelling (sharp vs. flat) is the analyst's call, not enum-constrained.

mode.description: A VocabTerm id, resolved against vocabulary.modes plus the built-in modes list shipped in code (major, minor, and the church modes). Project-level custom modes (e.g. Renaissance 8-mode/12-mode systems) go in vocabulary.modes.

SourceReference.description: Reference to the audio or video source. Stored as an object so that sourceOffset is unambiguously coupled to the source it describes.

url.description: Full YouTube video URL. Required when type = 'youtube'.

filename.description: Audio filename only (no folder path). Required when type = 'local'. Not shareable — the file must be present on the viewer's machine.

sourceOffset.description: Offset in seconds between the source file's start and the recording's true start. player_time = recording_time + sourceOffset. All span timestamps are stored in recording time. Updating the offset corrects all seek behavior without touching span data.

Vocabulary.description: Project-level custom vocabulary terms. pointMarkerTypes has v1 UI (required for classical scholars); spanTypes UI deferred to v2.

modes.description: Project-level custom modes (e.g. Renaissance 8-mode/12-mode systems, or any terminology beyond the built-in major/minor/church-mode starter list shipped in code).

id.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens. Used as the corpus-queryable type value in spans and point markers. Changing this ID breaks corpus queries against existing files.

label.description: Human-readable display name shown in the type picker.

description.description: Explanation shown as a tooltip when the analyst is choosing a type.

color.description: Optional default hex color for items of this type.

kind.description: Whether this term applies to spans, point markers, or modes. Required for vocabulary pack import to route terms correctly.

source.description: Pack provenance string, e.g. 'My Pack v1.0.0'. Set on import; absent for built-ins and project-local terms.

sourceLayerId.description: ID of the layer that contributed this time point, for provenance.

LayerRenderingConfig.description: Layer-level defaults for text rendering within span shapes. All spans in the layer inherit these settings. No per-span text rendering overrides in v1. Defaults: label above/center, annotation inside/left.

labelPosition.description: Where span labels render relative to the arc shape. 'above' = label floats above the arc peak (default); 'inside' = label renders inside the shape body. Applies to all spans in this layer.

labelJustification.description: Horizontal alignment of label text. Default: 'center'. Natural for section names above brackets.

annotationPosition.description: Where span annotation text renders relative to the arc shape. 'inside' = renders inside the shape body (default); 'above' = floats above the arc peak. Applies to all spans in this layer.

annotationJustification.description: Horizontal alignment of annotation text. Default: 'left'. Natural for analytical text inside brackets.

Layer.description: A widget layer instance. The typed envelope pattern: the core schema enforces all fields except data; the data field shape is defined by the widget type.

type.description: Widget type. v1: 'form-diagram' only. Future types: 'energy-contour', 'instrumentation', 'written-analysis'.

label.description: Short human-readable layer name. Displayed in the layer panel.

description.description: Optional longer description of this layer's analytical purpose or framework — e.g. 'Hepokoski/Darcy exposition analysis' or 'Phrase-level hypermeter, 4-bar units'. Distinct from label. Togglable visibility in the UI.

visibility.description: Hidden layers are excluded from exports.

locked.description: When true, the layer cannot be edited — only viewed and exported.

fillColorDefault.description: Fallback fill color for spans with no per-span fillColor override.

strokeColorDefault.description: Fallback stroke color for spans with no per-span strokeColor override.

displayOrder.description: Render order. Lower numbers render first (bottom of the visual stack). Gaps are allowed.

position.description: Position of this layer relative to the timeline ruler. Absent = use the widget type's defaultPosition from the WidgetDefinition. Absent widget default = 'above'. Set by the analyst per-layer in the layer settings popover.

rendering.description: Text rendering defaults for spans in this layer. Omit to use system defaults (label above/center, annotation inside/left).

spanShape.description: Visual style for this layer's spans. Absent/'bracket' = today's rendering (analytical bracket/arc shapes). 'bar' draws thin flat rects instead — intended for key-area layers (Span.keyArea captions), but the field is generic, not key-area-specific. A layer setting, buried in layer settings, not surfaced in the main add-layer flow. Purely visual; the same Span data model and interactions (spacebar, drag, merge) apply either way.

data.description: Widget-specific data payload. Shape is determined by the type field.

FormDiagramData.description: Data payload for a form-diagram layer.

hierarchicalEnforcement.description: STALE — unused by the UI, kept for file compatibility. Hierarchical enforcement was redefined (2026-06-22) as a cross-layer nesting constraint scoped to the form-diagram widget type; this field will be relocated when that feature is built (see docs/decisions.md). The schema always allows overlapping spans regardless.

Span.description: A time span representing a formal section. The universal primitive of the Strata system.

id.description: Auto-generated UUID. Never changes. Never shown to the user. Used for all inter-widget references and merge tracking.

label.description: Display name set by the analyst. Optional — null for unlabeled spans (e.g. bar-level hypermeter spans where the type carries the analytical meaning). Empty string is valid for a newly placed span awaiting a label.

shortLabel.description: Optional analyst-authored abbreviation of label (e.g. 'Verse 1' -> 'V1'). Shown above the shape in place of the full label when the full label doesn't fit at the current zoom; never itself truncated further. No algorithmic abbreviation is attempted for above-shape labels — if neither label nor shortLabel fits, nothing renders (the UI shows a small marker indicating a hidden label).

slug.description: Auto-generated from label — e.g. 'Drop 1' → 'drop-1'. Stable human-readable reference key for embeds and inter-widget links. Null if no label. Uniqueness is enforced by chronological position (startTime order) within the document, not by creation order.

startTime.description: Start of span in recording time, seconds (float).

endTime.description: End of span in recording time, seconds (float). Must exceed startTime.

type.description: Controlled vocabulary term ID. The corpus-queryable classification of this section. Separate from label by design.

fillColor.description: Per-span hex fill color override. Null = use layer fillColorDefault.

strokeColor.description: Per-span hex stroke color override. Null = use layer strokeColorDefault.

annotation.description: Diagram-visible text displayed on the span body alongside the label. For analytical observations that should appear on the diagram — e.g. 'filter sweep → snare roll', '+Kick', 'Anthem gradually emerges'. Distinct from notes (tooltip only) and from label (the section name). Feeds into the Written Analysis widget when built.

notes.description: Short freetext observation. Tooltip-level only — not rendered on the diagram.

lyrics.description: Lyric text occurring during this span. Not displayed on the form diagram by default. Corpus-queryable. Feeds into the Written Analysis widget.

keyArea.description: Free text, conventionally a Roman numeral relative to StrataDocument.homeKey (e.g. 'vi', 'V/V'). Corpus-queryable independently of label/type. Renders as a caption spanning the span — most naturally on a layer with spanShape = 'bar', but the field applies to any span.

confidence.description: Analyst's confidence in the placement of this span's boundaries. Optional — omit for 'definite' (default). Only set explicitly when marking a span as approximate or speculative.

startBoundaryType.description: Character of the formal transition at the start of this span. 'definite' = hard, precise cut; 'gradual' = inherently processual transition (a buildup that gradually becomes the section); 'elided' = this span's start is formally simultaneous with the end of the preceding span. Null or omit for 'definite'. Distinct from confidence: this describes the music's formal behavior, not the analyst's certainty about placement.

endBoundaryType.description: Character of the formal transition at the end of this span. 'elided' pairs with startBoundaryType = 'elided' on the following span to mark a reciprocal elision. When two adjacent spans share elided endpoints and their timestamps overlap, the renderer draws the elision visual (overlapping bracket).

parentId.description: Optional UUID reference to a parent span. Expresses hierarchical relationship without enforcing it in the data model.

mergedFrom.description: UUIDs of source spans when created by a merge. Enables reference resolution for inter-widget links that pointed to deprecated span IDs. Null for spans not produced by a merge. Always contains at least two IDs when present.

startCap.description: Visual cap (end-tail) style at the start of the bracket — the analyst's drawing choice, decoupled from startBoundaryType (which is analytical data). 'rounded' = vertical tail with a rounded corner; 'square' = sharp corner; 'angled' = diagonal tail; 'open' = no tail; 'elision' = vertical tail plus a lighter inner overlap line. The top line is always flat (domes/arcs are retired). Absent = 'rounded' (falls back from startBoundaryType for files authored before this field).

endCap.description: Visual cap style at the end of the bracket. Same values and defaulting as startCap; falls back from endBoundaryType when absent.

lineStyle.description: Visual stroke style of the whole bracket — the analyst's choice, decoupled from confidence. Whole-shape uniform; solid and dashed are never mixed at a shared edge. Absent = 'solid'.

PointMarker.description: A single-timestamp analytical event. Document-level — not per-layer.

flagged.description: 'Come back to this.' Simple bookmark for moments the analyst wants to revisit. Distinct from confidence — flagged means I want to return here, not I am uncertain about this. Optional — omit for false (default).

absent.description: 'This expected event was explicitly determined to be absent.' Analytically significant in H/D and similar frameworks where a missing event has formal consequences. No v1 UI — stored and preserved but not settable from the interface in v1. Optional — omit for false (default).

harmonicContext.description: Free text, conventionally a Roman numeral relative to StrataDocument.homeKey (e.g. 'V' for a half cadence in the dominant). Rendered as its own text near the marker — never force-concatenated with type. Corpus-queryable independently of the cadence type field.

confidence.description: Analyst's confidence in the identification and placement of this event. Optional — omit for 'definite' (default).

kind.description: Soft UI preset — picks which fields the Inspector panel leads with. Never restricts what data a marker can carry; every field remains reachable via 'more fields' regardless of kind. Omit/absent behaves like 'other'.
